on-video-ready.description: Triggers when rewarded video advert is ready to display

on-video-failed-to-load.description: Triggers when rewarded video advert fails to load

on-video-complete.description: Triggers when a rewarded video has completed

on-video-cancelled.description: Triggers when a rewarded video is cancelled

is-showing-video.description: returns true if a video advert is currently being displayed

is-loaded-video.description: returns true if a video advert is loaded

set-public-key.description: Configure Mobile Advert by setting various properties such as the app and publisher IDs.

set-user-personalisation.description: Change the user personalisation value. If your using the default user consent screen you do not need to set this

sort.description: Sort the elements on an axis.

advanced-audio-supported.description: True if advanced audio features are supported (Web Audio API).

set-from-text.description: Set buffer from string (encodes to UTF-8).

is-charging.description: False if device is battery-powered and is not plugged in, otherwise true.

is-metered.description: True if the connection is metered (e.g. pay-per-use).  False if not or if unknown.

on-menu-button.description: Triggers when device 'Menu' button is pressed.  Note not all devices have a 'Menu' button.

on-search-button.description: Triggers when device 'Search' button is pressed.  Note not all devices have a 'Search' button.

is-downloading-update.description: True when the browser is running from the offline cache, but downloading an update in the background.

on-update-ready.description: Triggered when an update has finished downloading.  You may want to prompt the user to reload the page.

page-is-visible.description: True if the page is currently visible to the user (e.g. in active tab or mobile app is in foreground).

on-resumed.description: Triggers when resuming (switched back to tab, restored window, mobile app returns to foreground, etc.)

on-suspended.description: Triggers when suspending (switched tab, minimized window, mobile app goes in to background, etc.)

supports-requesting-fullscreen.description: Check if the current browser/platform supports the 'Request fullscreen' action.

execute-javascript.description: Execute a string of javascript in the browser. Use with care!

batterylevel.description: Get battery charge level from 0 to 1, or 1 if unknown.

batterytimeleft.description: Get the time left in seconds before battery is fully discharged, if not charging.

product.description: Get the browser product name (e.g. Gecko).

execjs.description: Execute a string of javascript code and return a string or number. Wherever possible, prefer to use Construct's scripting feature or the Javascript SDK instead.

bandwidth.description: Estimated connection bandwidth in megabits/s if known (infinity if unknown).

connectiontype.description: Type of connection in use if known e.g. "wifi" or "cellular".

screenwidth.description: Get the width of the user's entire screen in pixels.

screenheight.description: Get the height of the user's entire screen in pixels.

devicepixelratio.description: The display pixels per CSS pixel.

windowinnerwidth.description: Get the width of the window client area in pixels.

windowinnerheight.description: Get the height of the window client area in pixels.

windowouterwidth.description: Get the width of the window outer area in pixels.

windowouterheight.description: Get the height of the window outer area in pixels.

set-player-id.description: Set the player identifier for leaderboard scores.

set-public-key.description: Set the public key for your application

transaction.description: In a trigger, the transaction information as a JSON string.

on-ready.description: Triggered when the Facebook API has loaded and is ready to be used.

on-user-top-score-available.description: Triggered after the 'request user top score' action.

on-hi-score.description: Triggered for each top score after the 'request hi-score board' action.

on-score-submitted.description: Triggered when the 'publish score' action completes.

log-in-deprecated.description: Log the user in to the application so their details can be accessed.

publish-score.description: Publish a score for this user.

userid.description: Get the user's ID, which is different even for users with the same name.

score.description: Get the score, when in a 'on user top score' or 'on hi-score' event.

hiscorerank.description: Get the rank of the hi-score, when in an 'on hi-score' event.

hiscoreuserid.description: Get the user ID of the user with hi-score, when in an 'on hi-score' event.

hiscoreuseridstr.description: Get the user ID string of the user with hi-score, when in an 'on hi-score' event.

gamepads-are-supported.description: True if the current platform or browser supports gamepad input.

lastbutton.description: 最后一次被按下或松开的游戏手柄按钮的索引。

start-screen-recording.description: Record a real-time video of the user's screen.

on-loaded.description: Triggered when game services have loaded and are ready to use.

share-leaderboard-update.description: Post a leaderboard update in to a message thread.

context-type.description: The type of the current game context, e.g. "THREAD" or "SOLO".

connected-player-name-at.description: The player name of a connected player at an index.

connected-player-photo-url-at.description: The photo URL of a connected player at an index.

leaderboard-player-name-at.description: The player name for a result at an index on a leaderboard.

leaderboard-player-photo-at.description: The player picture URL for a result at an index on a leaderboard.

leaderboard-rank-at.description: The rank of a result at an index on a leaderboard.

mesh.description: The current mesh. If more than one mesh is being drawn, the expression returns an empty string.

set-cursor-style.description: Change the style of the mouse cursor.

on-server-list-received.description: Triggered after 'Request server list' successfully completes.

supports-multiplayer.description: True if the current browser supports multiplayer games.

sync-object.description: Automatically synchronise an object type over the network.

request-server-list.description: Request a list of signalling servers that can be joined.

serverlistcount.description: The number of servers in a received server list.

serverlistnameat.description: The name of the Nth received signalling server.

serverlistoperatorat.description: The operator of the Nth received signalling server.

is-nwjs-export.description: True when running after an NW.js export.

is-windows-uwp-export.description: True when running after a Windows UWP export (Microsoft Store/Xbox One).

compare-z-height.description: 比较形状在Z轴方向的高度。
